  Readable gloss: "This numeral adjective means simply 'four thousand.' Acts 21:38 preserves a different use, where a Roman commander asks Paul whether he is the Egyptian who led four thousand assassins into the wilderness. Across all languages the rendering is a straightforward numeral — Spanish 'cuatro mil,' French 'quatre mille,' German 'viertausend.'"

Acts 21:38 uses it in a political context — the four thousand sicarii led by an Egyptian rebel. Every language renders it as a simple numeral: Spanish 'cuatro mil...
